content.text: Tau wa ena awayagara se ribagigiri,
ena baaea se bubulitawai, ia ie kode!
Tau wa nige ana giru GUIAU matana eai,
earuana eai nige abiborabora, ia ie kode hinage!
Huiana ne egu baaea nige ea hemasaraha, taugu se porohe ariri,
asubena maudoina ea lepalepa.
Asubena to maiona nimam potagu eai i porohe ariri,
egu adidiri ie ohi, doha siwaro lailai eai gigibori huiana eai.
Oa arim eai egu beaea ea hemasaraha,
eo egu ponori nige ea toreamui;
ea ene, “Egu awayagara wa abo ea ribahemasaraha GUIAU arinai,”
abotai egu baaea giruna u ribagigiri.
Arinai isi nuadi se ota esegai taba gamagaridi se uura arim eai;
huia baaea eai, abaita ena huia didi eai,
isi taba nige se hearo.
Oa egu ababawayamui ede,
piripiri aridi eai u ganahetaiirigu,
aridi eai u lebohaigu.
Abo ea heatam, em dobila abo ea heitam arinai bena u lau;
abo ea lauhasahasaim, matagu ede oa potam eai.
Oa tabu em abi doha hosi e doha mule, isi nige edi sibasiba;
arinai se paidi, eo awadi eai abawoeawoeaidi se heapudidinidi
bena abo se awa’abiem.
Tau laulau gewagewa ena nua’amamna se gamagari ariri,
na gadosisi miatahitahina GUIAU tausunumaena abo i hetaiiri.
Au kode GUIAU arinai, eo nuamiu se lolo, omi dudurai tataomiu e,
au eoga lailai, omi nuamiu se dudurai e!
